verdict.rationale: Datalab can be run headlessly through its own official CLI (`datalab convert document.pdf --format html`), a Python SDK and a REST API. Webhooks remove the need for polling, and a health-check endpoint supports scripted pipelines. These are first-party automation surfaces, but no evidence documents CI usage specifically. missing for 10: CI-specific documentation (e.g., CI pipeline examples, non-interactive auth/env-var guidance for CI runners, exit-code behavior), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the Datalab CLI to convert documents from the command line.
The Datalab Python SDK provides a simple interface for document conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management.
Webhooks provide real-time notifications when your document processing jobs complete, eliminating the need for continuous polling.
This endpoint is used to check the health of the API, given an API key.
